charts.title: TOI-5398 b: orbits around TOI-5398
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5398's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5398 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mantovan et al. 2024 (2024A&A...682A.129M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MANTOVAN_ET_AL_2024): P 10.590547 d

charts.title: TOI-5398 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5398 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 1 sector (48) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 8260536, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 17-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 17-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
